0022600198.text: The Timberwolves (7-3, on a three-game win streak and 0.5 games back of the division lead) host the Jazz (1-8, on a seven-game losing streak) as the Timberwolves' 11th game of the season. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery), with Joan Beringer day-to-day and a game-time decision because of a fracture, while Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (out, knee) and Jusuf Nurkic (out, foot strain), with Lauri Markkanen day-to-day and a game-time decision because of a wrist sprain. The Timberwolves won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 147-111 win in Minneapolis on March 18, and the two teams have not yet played each other this season.
